subject: WillowTech: hybrid workshop scheduling & calendar holds
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@willowtech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: WillowTech — hybrid workshop timing and holds

Hi Amanda,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. As discussed, we'd like to lock tentative calendar holds for the two-day technical + executive workshop so your teams can reserve travel where needed. We want to offer a hybrid option: Day 1 focused on engineering deep-dive (recommended onsite), Day 2 executive roadmap + Q&A (virtual streaming option).

Quick asks so we can finalize holds:
- Confirm expected headcount for onsite (engineers + TPMs) vs remote attendees.
- Any hard blackout dates 11/15–12/03 window?
- Preferred timezone constraints for your EU/Gua/Bang teams (we'll provide localized start times).
- Any procurement/PO information we should include on calendar invites.

Attached: initial agenda_v1.pdf and travel_matrix.xlsx (draft travel windows & hotel suggestions).

Proposed holds (tentative):
- Option A: 2026-11-23–11-24 (Mon–Tue) — SF onsite + global streaming
- Option B: 2026-12-01–12-02 (Tue–Wed) — SF onsite + shorter executive virtual day

If you prefer, we can also do a 1.5 day onsite (engineering half-day + executive half-day remote) to reduce travel.

I'll follow up with Monica to propose exact local start times for each major region (PST / CET / IST).

Thanks,
Rafael
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---

From: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@willowtech.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eng Team <eng-team@willowtech.com>, Procurement <procurement@willowtech.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: WillowTech — hybrid workshop timing and holds

Hi Rafael,

Thanks — this is helpful. Preliminary answers: 
- Onsite headcount: 6 engineers + 1 TPM + 1 IT/security lead. Potentially 2 execs for the executive day.
- Blackouts: We have year-end budgeting meetings 11/26–11/27; avoid those dates.
- Timezone notes: EU leads prefer not to start before 10:00 CET; our Bangalore team prefers afternoons IST (post-10:30 IST).
- Procurement: our procurement email is procurement@willowtech.com, PO process usually requires a 2-week lead after a SOW.

Option B looks safer given our calendar. Please propose localized times and any hotel blocks you recommend. Also can you share the SOC2 evidence/attestation checklist before booking travel (cc-ing our security lead).

Best,
Amanda Chen
VP, Engineering — WillowTech

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@willowtech.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: WillowTech — hybrid workshop timing and holds

Amanda, Rafael — thanks. I've attached travel_matrix.xlsx with recommended arrival windows and a one‑page hotel block suggestion near our SF office. Notes inside the sheet:
- Best arrival for engineers: arrive the evening before Day 1 (earlier travel for east coast/EU folks).
- Recommended flight booking window: 21–14 days out to balance fares and flexibility.
- We can organize airport pickup for the small onsite group.

Regarding SOC2: Rafael, can you loop in security materials (short checklist + link) so WillowTech procurement/security can triage before bookings?

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: travel_matrix.xlsx (flight windows, hotel pick-up notes)

---

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@willowtech.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-04T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: WillowTech — hybrid workshop timing and holds

Amanda — appreciate the constraints. Based on that, here's a concrete localized schedule proposal for Option B (2026-12-01–12-02):

Day 1 — Engineering Deep-dive (onsite) — 2026-12-01 (SF):
- Redwood start: 09:00 PST (Monterey Park HQ)
- London participants: 17:00 GMT (same day) — we propose heavy on recorded segments and critical syncs only
- Bangalore participants: 22:30 IST (same day) — recommend async contribs + two live blocks (22:30–23:30 IST for 60 min deep-dive)

Day 2 — Exec Roadmap + Q&A (virtual stream) — 2026-12-02:
- Redwood start: 11:00 PST
- London: 19:00 GMT
- Bangalore: 00:30 IST (next day) — we can flip the agenda to be shorter for APAC, plus we will record and provide follow-ups.

If those windows look acceptable we will:
1) Create tentative calendar blocks with "WillowTech — Redwood workshop (Tentative)" and the regional timing lines.
2) Send travel/hotel recommendations and a short SOC2 evidence packet (Will attach WillowTech_Risk_Questions.docx and SOC2 link).
3) Jordan will prepare logistics playbook for onsite AV and room layout.

Jordan — can you confirm AV capacity and any recommended room layout for 8 onsite + streaming?

Thanks,
Rafael

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@willowtech.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: WillowTech — hybrid workshop timing and holds

All — AV/logistics OK. Proposed onsite room layout: U-shape for whiteboarding + projector and a dedicated "remote table" with 2 camera angles. We'll provision:
- Two PTZ cameras + USB audio bar
- Dedicated laptop for streaming + backup hotspot
- Local AV tech onsite for check-in and run of show

I'll attach a one-page runbook to the calendar invite. Monica — can you include dietary restrictions when we confirm final headcount?

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: AV_runbook.pdf (stub referenced in calendar)

---

From: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@willowtech.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@willowtech.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: WillowTech — hybrid workshop timing and holds

Thanks, all — Option B works for initial planning. Procurement looped in. Next steps on our side:
- Procurement will review SOC2 packet and will be in touch re PO timeline.
- I'll confirm final onsite headcount by 2026-11-20.
- We prefer the 09:00 PST / 11:00 PST start times you proposed. Please go ahead and create tentative calendar invites showing local times and include the Zoom link.

I'll also share a small list of dietary restrictions when I confirm attendees.

Amanda

---

[Thread status: tentative holds created; attachments referenced. Calendar invites to be created once SOC2 packet shared and procurement confirms PO window.]
